title: Inhibition of STAT3-mediated glycolysis by bruceine D suppresses non-small-cell lung cancer progression in vitro and in vivo.
authors: Zhu, Yu; Xu, Xuan; Hong, Xiaofan; Zhang, Jiayi; Zhou, Yi; Sun, Aofeng; Ye, Yihan; Xu, Yini; Xu, Huanhai; Zhao, Haiyang; Zhao, Chengguang; Jin, Xing; Yang, Lehe; Zheng, Jianxiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物bruceine D抑制STAT3介导的糖酵解以抗肺癌，虽涉及STAT3蛋白与DNA结合相关的核转位及分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法上仅用MD辅助验证结合，缺乏AI或深度互作建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is one of the deadliest malignancies in the world. Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) plays an important role in the progression of NSCLC. Bruceine D is a bioactive quassinoid compound extracted from Brucea javanica, a plant widely used in traditional Chinese medicine. METHODS: Tests of cell function were performed to observe the effects of bruceine D on human NSCLC cell lines (H460, PC-9, and SKMES-1). Levels of STAT3, phosphorylated STAT3, Survivin, and other apoptosis-related proteins were detected via Western blotting. The binding of bruceine D to STAT3 was examined using molecular dynamics simulations and surface plasmon resonance spectroscopy. The effect of bruceine D on STAT3 nuclear localization was examined by immunofluorescence. Furthermore, the glucose uptake, lactate production, and extracellular acidification rates of NSCLC cells were analyzed to confirm that bruceine D inhibited glycolysis in NSCLC. The efficacy of bruceine D in vivo was evaluated in a mouse xenotransplantation model. RESULTS: Bruceine D significantly reduced the viability of NSCLC cells, promoted apoptosis, and inhibited the growth of tumors in a mouse xenograft model. Bruceine D was found to bind directly to STAT3, inhibiting glycolysis in NSCLC cells. Western blotting results suggested that the antitumor effects of bruceine D might be mediated by the inhibition of the phosphorylation and nuclear translocation of STAT3. CONCLUSION: Bruceine D exerts a strong inhibitory effect on NSCLC in vitro and in vivo. Bruceine D has potential application prospects in the field of anti-NSCLC therapy.
abstract_zh: 背景：非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）是全球最致命的恶性肿瘤之一。信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）在NSCLC的进展中发挥重要作用。鸦胆子素D是从鸦胆子（Brucea javanica）中提取的一种具有生物活性的苦木素类化合物，该植物在传统中药中广泛使用。方法：通过细胞功能测试观察鸦胆子素D对人NSCLC细胞系（H460、PC-9和SKMES-1）的影响。使用Western blotting检测STAT3、磷酸化STAT3、Survivin及其他凋亡相关蛋白的水平。通过分子动力学模拟和表面等离子体共振光谱法检测鸦胆子素D与STAT3的结合。通过免疫荧光检测鸦胆子素D对STAT3核定位的影响。此外，分析NSCLC细胞的葡萄糖摄取、乳酸产生和细胞外酸化速率，以确认鸦胆子素D抑制NSCLC中的糖酵解。在小鼠异种移植模型中评估鸦胆子素D的体内疗效。结果：鸦胆子素D显著降低NSCLC细胞的活力，促进凋亡，并抑制小鼠异种移植模型中肿瘤的生长。发现鸦胆子素D直接与STAT3结合，抑制NSCLC细胞中的糖酵解。Western blotting结果表明，鸦胆子素D的抗肿瘤作用可能通过抑制STAT3的磷酸化和核转位来介导。结论：鸦胆子素D在体外和体内对NSCLC表现出强效抑制作用。鸦胆子素D在抗NSCLC治疗领域具有潜在的应用前景。
